reference: Coolapk 16.6.4 APK and daimiaopeng/coolapk-desktop (MIT) client.rs, TopicPage.vue, VoteCard.vue, QuestionDetailPage.vue, LiveDetailPage.vue
evidence: 4 protocol tests, 8 community renderer checks, 4 article checks, 4 photo gallery checks, 11 publishing checks, existing 8 media regression checks and TypeScript validation pass. Renderer checks block all remote requests. No actual account mutations were performed. Publishing checks decode a real browser-recorded H264 MP4 and generate a JPEG cover.
